I present to you a historically accurate, working model of the engine of the RMS titanic. Back in the day the RMS stood for Royal Mail Steamer aka steamship 

In a steam engine you boil water in the boiler, water turns into steam and travels through a tube or pipe. The steam is contained in the tube until enough water has boiled away and the pressure of the contained steam has risen sufficiently. Once pressure has built up you start the engine.
